title: A Likely Geometry of Generative Models
abstract: arXiv:2510.26266v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The geometry of generative models serves as the basis for interpolation, model inspection, and more. Unfortunately, most generative models lack a principal notion of geometry without restrictive assumptions on either the model or the data dimension. In this paper, we construct a general geometry compatible with different metrics and probability distributions to analyze generative models that do not require additional training. We consider curves analogous to geodesics constrained to a suitable data distribution aimed at targeting high-density regions learned by generative models. We formulate this as a (pseudo)-metric and prove that this corresponds to a Newtonian system on a Riemannian manifold. We show that shortest paths in our framework can be characterized by a system of ordinary differential equations, which locally corresponds to geodesics under a suitable Riemannian metric. translated_abstract: 生成模型的几何结构是插值、模型检查等诸多任务的基础。遗憾的是，在不模型或数据维度施加限制性假设的情况下，大多数生成模型缺乏一个基本的几何概念。本文构建了一种兼容不同度量和概率分布的通用几何结构，用于分析生成模型，且无需额外训练。我们考虑了类似于测地线的曲线，将其约束在适当的数据分布上，旨在定位生成模型所学习到的高密度区域。我们将其形式化为一种（伪）度量，并证明其对应于黎曼流形上的一个牛顿力学系统。我们证明，该框架中的最短路径可由一组常微分方程刻画，且在局部上对应于适当黎曼度量下的测地线。在数值方面，我们提出了一种新颖的高效算法。
tldr: 提出了一种无需额外训练、兼容不同度量与概率分布的生成模型几何框架，通过约束在高密度数据区域的类测地线曲线和常微分方程组来刻画生成模型空间中的最短路径。
en_tdlr: Proposes a training-free geometric framework for generative models, compatible with diverse metrics and distributions, that characterizes shortest paths as geodesic-like curves constrained to high-density data regions via a system of ODEs.
